BiblicalUsage: The word is to feed, to cause to eat, in Aramaic. Nebuchadnezzar was driven from men and did eat grass as oxen, till he knew that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and Belshazzar's father was made to eat grass as oxen before he learned the same.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the king who ate grass learned what the beasts know: the Most High rules, and man is fed at His hand.
